name: Weed Snobs Diamond Infused Preroll | Grand Daddy Purple
description: Granddaddy Purple is a indica dominate strain that is a rather popular cross of Purple Urkle and Big Bud. It has flavors of berry, grape and other spices. It is typically high in Caryophyllene, alpha-Pinene, and Humulene. This strain produces mostly relaxed, sleepy and euphoric effects.
